templates.emacs-theme.el:
;;; marchyo-theme.el --- Generated by marchyo from the current theme  -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-

(deftheme marchyo "Colours of the current marchyo theme.")

(let* ((bg "{{token:bg}}")
       (bg1 "{{token:bg-subtle}}")
       (blue "{{token:syn-function}}")
       (cyan "{{token:syn-type}}")
       (doc "{{token:syn-docstring}}")
       (faint "{{token:text-faint}}")
       (fg "{{token:text}}")
       (green "{{token:syn-string}}")
       (magenta "{{token:syn-keyword}}")
       (muted "{{token:text-muted}}")
       (orange "{{token:syn-number}}")
       (red "{{token:status-err}}")
       (sel "{{token:selection-bg}}")
       (yellow "{{token:status-warn}}"))
  (custom-theme-set-faces
   'marchyo
   `(cursor ((t (:background ,fg))))
   `(default ((t (:background ,bg :foreground ,fg))))
   `(error ((t (:foreground ,red))))
   `(font-lock-builtin-face ((t (:foreground ,cyan))))
   `(font-lock-comment-face ((t (:foreground ,faint :slant italic))))
   `(font-lock-constant-face ((t (:foreground ,orange))))
   `(font-lock-doc-face ((t (:foreground ,doc))))
   `(font-lock-function-name-face ((t (:foreground ,blue))))
   `(font-lock-keyword-face ((t (:foreground ,magenta))))
   `(font-lock-preprocessor-face ((t (:foreground ,yellow))))
   `(font-lock-string-face ((t (:foreground ,green))))
   `(font-lock-type-face ((t (:foreground ,yellow))))
   `(font-lock-variable-name-face ((t (:foreground ,red))))
   `(font-lock-warning-face ((t (:foreground ,red :weight bold))))
   `(fringe ((t (:background ,bg :foreground ,faint))))
   `(header-line ((t (:background ,bg1 :foreground ,fg))))
   `(highlight ((t (:background ,sel))))
   `(hl-line ((t (:background ,bg1 :extend t))))
   `(isearch ((t (:background ,yellow :foreground ,bg))))
   `(lazy-highlight ((t (:background ,sel :foreground ,fg))))
   `(line-number ((t (:background ,bg :foreground ,faint))))
   `(line-number-current-line ((t (:background ,bg1 :foreground ,fg))))
   `(link ((t (:foreground ,blue :underline t))))
   `(link-visited ((t (:foreground ,magenta :underline t))))
   `(minibuffer-prompt ((t (:foreground ,blue :weight bold))))
   `(mode-line ((t (:background ,bg1 :foreground ,fg :box nil))))
   `(mode-line-inactive ((t (:background ,bg1 :foreground ,muted :box nil))))
   `(region ((t (:background ,sel :extend t))))
   `(secondary-selection ((t (:background ,bg1))))
   `(shadow ((t (:foreground ,faint))))
   `(show-paren-match ((t (:background ,sel :foreground ,yellow :weight bold))))
   `(success ((t (:foreground ,green))))
   `(tab-bar ((t (:background ,bg1 :foreground ,muted))))
   `(tab-bar-tab ((t (:background ,bg :foreground ,fg))))
   `(tab-bar-tab-inactive ((t (:background ,bg1 :foreground ,muted))))
   `(vertical-border ((t (:foreground ,faint))))
   `(warning ((t (:foreground ,yellow))))
   `(window-divider ((t (:foreground ,faint))))
   `(ansi-color-black ((t (:foreground "{{token:bg}}" :background "{{token:bg}}"))))
   `(ansi-color-bright-black ((t (:foreground "{{token:text-faint}}" :background "{{token:text-faint}}"))))
   `(ansi-color-red ((t (:foreground "{{token:status-err}}" :background "{{token:status-err}}"))))
   `(ansi-color-bright-red ((t (:foreground "{{token:status-err}}" :background "{{token:status-err}}"))))
   `(ansi-color-green ((t (:foreground "{{token:syn-string}}" :background "{{token:syn-string}}"))))
   `(ansi-color-bright-green ((t (:foreground "{{token:syn-string}}" :background "{{token:syn-string}}"))))
   `(ansi-color-yellow ((t (:foreground "{{token:status-warn}}" :background "{{token:status-warn}}"))))
   `(ansi-color-bright-yellow ((t (:foreground "{{token:status-warn}}" :background "{{token:status-warn}}"))))
   `(ansi-color-blue ((t (:foreground "{{token:syn-function}}" :background "{{token:syn-function}}"))))

;;; marchyo-theme.el --- Generated by marchyo from the current theme  -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-

(deftheme marchyo "Colours of the current marchyo theme.")

(let* ((bg "#1a1b26")
       (bg1 "#16161e")
       (blue "#2ac3de")
       (cyan "#b4f9f8")
       (doc "#f7768e")
       (faint "#444b6a")
       (fg "#a9b1d6")
       (green "#9ece6a")
       (magenta "#bb9af7")
       (muted "#787c99")
       (orange "#a9b1d7")
       (red "#c53b53")
       (sel "#2f3549")
       (yellow "#0db9d7"))
  (custom-theme-set-faces
   'marchyo
   `(cursor ((t (:background ,fg))))
   `(default ((t (:background ,bg :foreground ,fg))))
   `(error ((t (:foreground ,red))))
   `(font-lock-builtin-face ((t (:foreground ,cyan))))
   `(font-lock-comment-face ((t (:foreground ,faint :slant italic))))
   `(font-lock-constant-face ((t (:foreground ,orange))))
   `(font-lock-doc-face ((t (:foreground ,doc))))
   `(font-lock-function-name-face ((t (:foreground ,blue))))
   `(font-lock-keyword-face ((t (:foreground ,magenta))))
   `(font-lock-preprocessor-face ((t (:foreground ,yellow))))
   `(font-lock-string-face ((t (:foreground ,green))))
   `(font-lock-type-face ((t (:foreground ,yellow))))
   `(font-lock-variable-name-face ((t (:foreground ,red))))
   `(font-lock-warning-face ((t (:foreground ,red :weight bold))))
   `(fringe ((t (:background ,bg :foreground ,faint))))
   `(header-line ((t (:background ,bg1 :foreground ,fg))))
   `(highlight ((t (:background ,sel))))
   `(hl-line ((t (:background ,bg1 :extend t))))
   `(isearch ((t (:background ,yellow :foreground ,bg))))
   `(lazy-highlight ((t (:background ,sel :foreground ,fg))))
   `(line-number ((t (:background ,bg :foreground ,faint))))
   `(line-number-current-line ((t (:background ,bg1 :foreground ,fg))))
   `(link ((t (:foreground ,blue :underline t))))
   `(link-visited ((t (:foreground ,magenta :underline t))))
   `(minibuffer-prompt ((t (:foreground ,blue :weight bold))))
   `(mode-line ((t (:background ,bg1 :foreground ,fg :box nil))))
   `(mode-line-inactive ((t (:background ,bg1 :foreground ,muted :box nil))))
   `(region ((t (:background ,sel :extend t))))
   `(secondary-selection ((t (:background ,bg1))))
   `(shadow ((t (:foreground ,faint))))
   `(show-paren-match ((t (:background ,sel :foreground ,yellow :weight bold))))
   `(success ((t (:foreground ,green))))
   `(tab-bar ((t (:background ,bg1 :foreground ,muted))))
   `(tab-bar-tab ((t (:background ,bg :foreground ,fg))))
   `(tab-bar-tab-inactive ((t (:background ,bg1 :foreground ,muted))))
   `(vertical-border ((t (:foreground ,faint))))
   `(warning ((t (:foreground ,yellow))))
   `(window-divider ((t (:foreground ,faint))))
   `(ansi-color-black ((t (:foreground "#1a1b26" :background "#1a1b26"))))
   `(ansi-color-bright-black ((t (:foreground "#444b6a" :background "#444b6a"))))

  return 0.2126 * tonumber(r, 16) + 0.7152 * tonumber(g, 16) + 0.0722 * tonumber(b, 16)
